column1: ## Repository Table R16. Published HAQER contexts displayed in Figure 4

## Description: The 12 contexts used in the main HAQER illustration. Contexts were selected for model disagreement and are not an unbiased estimate of sensitivity. Gene proximity does not establish a regulatory target. The common threshold 0.59 was selected on validation data; callers use different smoothing and peak criteria.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | HAQER identifier | HAQER identifier for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Chromosome | Chromosome for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Context start (0-based) | Beginning of the stated genomic interval; coordinates follow the table-specific convention.
## Column 4 | Context end (exclusive) | End of the stated interval or recorded range; interval convention is stated above.
## Column 5 | HAQER start (0-based) | Beginning of the stated genomic interval; coordinates follow the table-specific convention.
## Column 6 | HAQER end (exclusive) | End of the stated interval or recorded range; interval convention is stated above.
## Column 7 | Data split | Data split for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 8 | Nearby-gene context | Nearby-gene context for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 9 | HAQER catalogue reference | HAQER catalogue reference for the observation defined in the table description.
